key_insight: JGRA uses Jacobian geometry to quantify how sensitive noise-aware quantum neural networks are to NISQ perturbations, turning robustness into a measurable geometric property.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps engineers assess and compare QNN designs for noise resilience before deployment on noisy quantum hardware.
method: Calibrate synthetic noise to match entropy of target NISQ conditions.
Train QNNs with noise awareness to reflect realistic inference behavior.
Extract noise-conditioned Jacobians and derive geometric descriptors linked to robustness.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical results showing that the Jacobian-based descriptors predict robustness under unseen noise.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate noise calibration, so mismatch between assumed and actual hardware noise could weaken its reliability.
paper_title: JGRA: Jacobian Geometry Robustness Assessment in NISQ Noise-Aware Quantum Neural Networks
